Hero.name: Nourhen Bourannen
Hero.tagline: I build modern web applications with the MERN stack, and I'm now moving into data science.

About.title: About me
About.text: I'm a recent Computer Science graduate from ISET Gafsa (Information Systems Development), with a strong foundation in full-stack development using the MERN stack. I enjoy building complete products, from the database to the user interface, and I'm now deepening my skills with a master's degree in Data Science. I also work as a freelance web QA tester, so quality is part of how I build.

Skills.title: Skills
Skills.learning: Currently building hands-on data projects as part of my Master's in Data Science.

bullets: Performed manual testing of websites and web applications.
Tested forms, login/authentication, navigation, and main user workflows.
Identified and documented functional and UI bugs.
Checked responsive behavior on different screen sizes and browsers.
Verified bug fixes and performed basic regression testing.
Prepared clear bug reports with reproduction steps and expected results.
Built two web applications with the MERN stack: a social media app and an e-commerce store.
Used Git for version control on both projects.

smarttrade.title: SMART-TRADE 360°
smarttrade.description: My end-of-studies project (2026), built for ETAP in a team of two. A full-stack commercial management platform with a MERN web app, a mobile app, an AI chatbot, an AI-powered security mode that detects anomalies, and QR code and PDF generation.
